subject: Zoning Ordinance Update and Consultant Funding
overview: The Council approved a $10,000 appropriation for code enforcement cameras and initiated a process to hire a consultant for a citywide zoning update. The meeting also addressed extensive requests for sidewalk repairs and traffic safety improvements.

items.title: Annie's Pizzeria Permit Review
items.summary: Approved continuing the special permit for 90 days after code enforcement reported no complaints.

items.title: Licenses and PTO Food Trucks
items.summary: Approved common victualler licenses for Wakeman's and Rose's Roast Beef and Pizza, and food trucks for a Brooks PTO fundraiser.

items.title: Code Enforcement Camera Appropriation
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $10,000 from free cash to purchase three portable infrared cameras for monitoring illegal dumping and criminal activity.

items.title: Adopt-a-Site Program Expansion
items.summary: Approved a resolution to expand the program to include grass islands on Lawrence Road and Governor's Avenue.

items.title: Water Leak Detection Update
items.summary: Approved requesting an update on the leak detection program and calling for municipal water usage to be included in the operating budget to increase accountability.

items.title: Zoning Law Update and Consultant
items.summary: Approved requesting free cash to hire an outside consultant for a comprehensive zoning update and scheduled a meeting with the Metropolitan Area Planning Council. Councilors and residents debated the impact of residential development and the need to protect the city's commercial tax base.

items.title: Sidewalk, Stump, and Infrastructure Maintenance
items.summary: Approved a series of resolutions for sidewalk repairs and stump removals, including a demand for a public inventory of asphalt patches and the removal of a hazardous firebox base. Councilors and residents criticized the lack of transparency in the current repair list and the dangers posed by incomplete work.

items.title: Riverside Plaza Project Update
items.summary: Approved a request for a written update on the project's spending and remaining funding requirements.

items.title: Ceremonial Commendations
items.summary: Recognized Eagle Scout Duncan McLean, Patriot Award recipient Henry Millering, and Rose DeLuca on her 90th birthday.

items.title: Traffic Safety and Intersection Improvements
items.summary: Referred requests for traffic mirrors at blind intersections on Fulton Street and safety inspections for Route 16 turns to the traffic commission.

items.title: Meeting Schedule Change
items.summary: Failed a motion to reschedule the October 31st meeting to avoid Halloween.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of the September 19 and October 3 meetings with one sponsorship correction.
